# Foxlet Translate 0.5.0

Binary supplied by the user, verified against the [upstream release](https://github.com/yinvoke/foxlet-translate/releases/tag/v0.5.0): SHA-256 `5dbb384907d69c2aba129fd15dba30dda94ede0fa556dc6a167d041ee479ec0e`. Sources and licenses are provided by the upstream project and embedded in the AAR under `io/github/yinvoker/foxlet/licenses/`. Mozilla translation models are downloaded separately and carry their own licenses. The SDK supports Android 9+ and arm64 only.
